source: corpus-classifier proposal (2026-06-11) synthesizing rag_index/databases.json (declared) + proposed enrichments
purpose: Machine-readable crosswalk: which of the 9 databases feeds which of the 13 RAG data-niches, with provenance. 'declared' rows come from databases.json feeds_niches (authoritative). 'proposed' rows are corpus-classifier enrichments PENDING a human gate (do not treat as authoritative until approved). Provenance enum makes the LBPP discipline queryable: prefer physical (IntAct) > genetic (BioGRID) > predicted (STRING).
edge_provenance_rule: For any interaction/edge claim, rank IntAct(physical) > BioGRID(genetic) > STRING(predicted). A STRING-only edge is tagged provenance:predicted and the record carries gap_flag 'physical corroboration absent'.
human_gate: The 'proposed' feeds are corpus-classifier enrichments — confirm via the corpus-classifier audit path + a human gate before treating as declared (ADR-0017).
